title: 30A COASTAL BREEZE | Santa Rosa Beach, FL | Five Star Properties
meta_description: 30A Coastal Breeze - Luxury Vacation Rental on 30A with Resort Style Community PoolFavorite Features:- Large Community Pool
description_expanded: 30A Coastal Breeze - Luxury Vacation Rental on 30A with Resort Style Community Pool Favorite Features: - Large Community Pool - Golf Cart Included - Two Living Spaces - Private Sauna Welcome to your ultimate oasis! 30A Coastal Breeze is an expansive and luxurious home located in the highly sought-after Cypress Breeze Plantation gated community. With a whopping 3,700 square feet of living space, this vacation rental can easily accommodate up to 10 guests, making it perfect for large groups and multi-family vacations. As a guest, you'll have the privilege of enjoying exclusive access to the community's outstanding amenities, including a sprawling resort-style pool and picturesque walking trails. And that's not all - the home itself boasts a range of private amenities, such as a sauna, fire pit, and even a golf cart to make your trips to the beach even more enjoyable. With two living spaces, there's ample space for everyone to relax and unwind in style! 30A Coastal Breeze provides a seamless blend of indoor and outdoor living spaces. The first-floor living room offers a stylish wet bar with an ice maker, an inviting fireplace, and a large TV, this space is perfect for unwinding after a day of adventure. Make yourself a cold drink and venture to the outdoor lounge area, where another TV, bar with seating, and large grill await. Whether you're hosting a lively gathering or enjoying a peaceful evening with loved ones, this space sets the stage for unforgettable moments. Here, is also where you will access the massive, three-tier, resort-style pool directly.  Upon ascending to the second floor, you will find the main living room and kitchen. The plush living room invites you to sink in and relax after a day of sun-soaked adventures. It seamlessly transitions to the balcony which is equipped with a cozy firepit, a top-of-the-line Green Egg grill, and an outdoor dining area, making it the perfect spot to enjoy delicious meals with your loved ones while enjoying the beauty of your surroundings. On chilly nights, guests can sit by the fire pit and enjoy the beautiful view of the pool while staying warm. Cook in luxury with this high-end kitchen, where every detail has been meticulously crafted for the ultimate culinary experience. The centerpiece is a state-of-the-art 6-burner gas stove with a griddle and high-end appliances, perfect for gourmet cooking and meal preparation. The sleek countertops provide ample space for food prep and presentation, exuding elegance and sophistication.  Guests will appreciate the private sauna with a radio, which is perfect for relaxing after a long day at the beach.  A golf cart is provided, bringing the beach just a five-minute ride through the picturesque neighborhood and directly past Gulf Place, an entertainment epicenter that hosts boutique shops, art galleries, and eateries serving up delicious coastal cuisine. Visitors can stroll along the streets, browse local artwork, and indulge in freshly caught seafood at one of the many restaurants. Experience the ultimate resort-style living, designed to offer guests a relaxing and enjoyable space to unwind and soak up the Coastal Breeze of 30A. Book your stay today! Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 2: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub. THIRD FLOOR Bedroom 3: Queen Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 4: Queen Bed & Jack and Jill Ensuite Bathroom with Shower.  Shared Balcony & Pool View. Bedroom 5: Queen Bed & Jack and Jill Ensuite Bathroom with Shower.  Shared Balcony & Pool View.
